integrated_multimodal_description: A scene from Beverly Hills Cop, live-action cinematic, high action sequence in a futuristic city at night under heavy rain. The camera locks off in a static medium-long shot, framing Eddie Murphy as Axel Foley sprinting directly toward the lens through a neon-drenched street. He wears his iconic Detroit Lions varsity jacket, the crimson fabric slick with rain, over a white t-shirt and dark jeans. His face is set in focused intensity, The environment is a cyberpunk sprawl of towering glass structures and pulsing LED billboards casting cyan and magenta reflections on the wet asphalt. Rain hammers the ground in a constant hiss, mixing with the roar of engines and distant explosions.

[Shot 1] live-action cinematic, high action sequence in a futuristic city at night under heavy rain. The camera holds a static shot, framing Eddie Murphy as Axel Foley sprinting directly toward the lens through a neon-drenched street. He wears his iconic Detroit Lions varsity jacket, the crimson fabric slick with rain, over a white t-shirt and dark jeans. His face is set in focused intensity, The environment is a cyberpunk sprawl of towering glass structures and pulsing LED billboards casting cyan and magenta reflections on the wet asphalt. Rain hammers the ground in a constant hiss, mixing with the roar of engines and distant explosions. Axel’s strides are long and confident, his boots splashing through puddles that ripple with electric light. A futuristic hover-car zips past on his left, its undercarriage glowing blue, forcing him to weave sharply right without breaking rhythm. Behind him, a massive structural pillar explodes in a burst of concrete dust and fire, the shockwave rippling the air but leaving Axel untouched as he continues forward.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a low-angle static shot from ground level, looking up at Axel as he approaches. A sleek black sedan skids into frame from the right, tires screeching on wet pavement. As it passes him, the driver loses control and slams head-on into another vehicle ahead. Metal crumples violently, glass shatters into a spray of diamond fragments that catch the neon light, and sparks fly in a shower of orange debris. Axel jumps cleanly over the collapsing hood of the first car, his legs extending in mid-air, jacket flapping behind him. The impact sends shockwaves through the pavement, but he lands softly on the other side, momentum carrying him forward without pause. Behind him, a drone drops a small bomb that detonates near his feet, sending a concussive ring of force outward; Axel ducks slightly to avoid the blast radius, debris flying past his ear.

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to a static close-up as Axel comes to a sudden stop inches from the lens. He plants his feet firmly, the wet asphalt squelching under his weight. He points one finger directly at the viewer, his expression shifting from exertion to a sly, mischievous grin. His voice, bright and raspy with a playful lilt, (S1), says, <d>Gotcha bitch!</d> The line hangs in the air for a beat before he breaks into the classic wide-open Eddie Murphy laugh, his head tipping back as rain drips from his chin. Behind him, the street continues to erupt in secondary explosions and crumpling metal, but he remains the calm, grinning center of the chaos.

overall_soundscape: A constant bed of heavy rain hitting pavement and glass creates a rhythmic hiss underlay. Layered over this are the sharp screech of tires on wet asphalt, the deep rumble of engine roars, and the violent crackle of metal crumpling during collisions. Explosions provide low-frequency thuds that vibrate through the frame, accompanied by the high-pitched fizz of sparks and the shattering pop of breaking glass. Axel’s footsteps are distinct splashes, punctuating his sprint with a wet, heavy cadence. The air feels thick with humidity and ozone from the electrical lights.

non_diegetic_music: A driving, futuristic electro-cyber track pulses throughout, featuring a deep, booming kick drum that syncs with the explosions and Axel’s strides. Synth basslines weave through the mix, adding a rhythmic urgency that builds in intensity as the destruction escalates. The melody is bright and energetic, using arpeggiated leads to maintain a sense of fun and momentum despite the chaos, peaking in volume during the final jump and settling into a lighter, playful synth riff as Axel lands and laughs.

PLAGUEKIND V9 · REFERENCE GENERATION

Two images are visible on the main canvas. Open Extra References for Picture 3-9, Video 1-3 and Audio 1-3.

Every reference has an Optional Reference gate in that same group. Picture 1 and 2 start enabled; all other media start disabled. Set enabled=true only for media you loaded. Keep unused slots false: their loaders will not run. Video soundtracks have independent gates.

Use <Picture 1>..<Picture 9>, <Video 1>..<Video 3>, <Audio 1>..<Audio 3> in the prompt for enabled media.

The reference image is subject conditioning, not automatically the first frame.

SLA Density Notes:

0.80-0.85 - "match pytorch quality"

0.9 - Default - Minimal Degredation 

0.95 - HUGE boost, 2d/anime use.

---
Comfy Density Notes:

Reference protection is semi built into sparsity, but the options work as well. changing sparsity doesn't massively change speed. Test it.
It shouldn't need protect audio.

### V9 Notes

- UPDATE NODEPACK TO V1.4.7 AND COMFYUI TO NEWEST VERSION.
- New mode for sparse, comfy engine, better quality and faster.
- Added Int8 Kernel.
- I set 0.7 sparsity because it's not much slower on comfy engine, mess with it.
- Added H3 cache, default is safe.
- Added Bypass for R2V VAE.
- Upscaling is still WIP, mess with it.

---
- Added my turbo lora, functional strength up to 5.0
- Test default settings, they should be good for most prompts.
- If you don't like mine on it's own, try blending the disabled fast lora with it, looks really good.
- Res multi step simple also works well.
- Make sure you're on the newest pytorch+cu combo supported, and newest nodepack + comfy.
- When ref swapping a video use er_sde.
- Added original audio mode, avoids degradation and vae decode / Allows you to make music videos etc. it's in the reference subgraph.
- Added FSR RCAS sharpening, 0.3 strength looks natural.

Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.
